contract.text: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one (1) year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term. Notice must be sent to legal@vendor.com or by certified mail to the address on file.

cancellation.text: Hi team, we'd like to cancel our subscription and not renew for next year. Please confirm. Thanks, Jane

auto_renewal_clause.instructions: Read state.contract.text. Determine whether the contract automatically renews for another term unless the customer affirmatively cancels or gives notice of non-renewal.

criteria.true: The contract contains an automatic/evergreen renewal clause: it renews by default unless the customer opts out or gives notice.
criteria.false: The contract has no auto-renewal clause, or renewal requires the customer's affirmative opt-in (renewal is not automatic).

required_notice_days.instructions: Read state.contract.text. Identify how many days of advance notice, before the end of the current term, the contract requires in order to prevent automatic renewal. Pick the closest matching bucket.

criteria.15_days: Contract requires roughly 15 days (1-20 days) of advance notice.
criteria.30_days: Contract requires roughly 30 days (21-35 days) of advance notice.
criteria.45_days: Contract requires roughly 45 days (36-50 days) of advance notice.
criteria.60_days: Contract requires roughly 60 days (51-75 days) of advance notice.
criteria.90_days: Contract requires roughly 90 days (76-105 days) of advance notice.
criteria.120_days: Contract requires roughly 120 days or more (106+ days) of advance notice.
criteria.other_or_unspecified: No numeric notice period is stated, the period doesn't fit any bucket above, or there is no renewal-notice requirement at all.

valid_cancellation_notice.instructions: Read state.cancellation.text and any notice-form requirements in state.contract.text (e.g. required recipient, written form, method of delivery). Determine whether the cancellation email is unambiguous notice of cancellation/non-renewal and satisfies any stated form requirements.

criteria.true: The email clearly states intent to cancel or not renew, and meets any form requirements the contract specifies (or the contract specifies none).
criteria.false: The email is ambiguous or doesn't clearly request cancellation/non-renewal, or it fails a specific form requirement stated in the contract (e.g. wrong recipient, wrong method).

notice_timely.instructions: Using the notice period required by state.contract.text, state.contract.current_term_end, and state.cancellation.date_received, determine whether the cancellation was received early enough to meet the contract's notice deadline and avoid automatic renewal.

criteria.true: state.cancellation.date_received is on or before the deadline implied by the contract's notice period counted back from state.contract.current_term_end.
criteria.false: state.cancellation.date_received is after that deadline, so notice was too late to prevent auto-renewal.
